$comment: Response headers for the deployed app. Mirrored in the repository-level vercel.json and serve.json for /pages/Silence-Cutter/*, and applied by `vite preview` (vite.config.ts) so tests run under the production policy. connect-src only allows this origin and Hugging Face (model downloads): the browser itself blocks any attempt to send data elsewhere.
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' blob: data: https://huggingface.co https://*.huggingface.co https://*.hf.co; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'self'
